rules.strategy: Collective problem-solving strategy (audit): inspect the target file/table with repo_read and run python_interpreter to verify row totals, invariants, and anomalies.
Collective problem-solving strategy (benchmark): execute controlled timing probes via run_shell and compute throughput/latency distributions with python_interpreter.
Collective problem-solving strategy (corroborate): retrieve primary figures via web.search/web.page and cross-verify quantitative claims using python_interpreter before answering.
Collective problem-solving strategy (forecast): gather current historical series via web.search and fit a quantitative projection in python_interpreter.
Collective problem-solving strategy (reconcile): read the referenced ledgers/files via repo_read and reconcile line-by-line discrepancies in python_interpreter.
